task_summary: Customer reports that NoiseBlock Earbuds from order ORD-6023 were damaged in transit due to crushed packaging. Proper procedure: acknowledge the shipping damage, review refund and return policy, process a full refund to original payment, provide a prepaid return label, and if the item is fragile, also include a separate goodwill credit.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: I received my NoiseBlock Earbuds from order ORD-6023, but the packaging was crushed and they arrived damaged.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You ordered NoiseBlock Earbuds under order ORD-6023, and they arrived damaged because the package was crushed. You want a full refund to your original payment method. If the item is fragile, you expect to also receive a separate fragile-item goodwill credit.
